Clear out the great [[Temple of War]] in the center of the Fissure and seek out the [[Eternal Forgemaster]] for armor fitting of a great hero.  This is the start of the quest chain necessary to craft [[Obsidian armor]].

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
* Clear the Temple of War of enemies!
* Seek out the Forgemaster at the temple of War.
* See Eternal Forgemaster for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
To spawn the Eternal Weaponsmith to get this quest, clear out the camp on the west side of the [[Great Battle Field]].

The Temple sits atop the large hill in the center of the Fissure, and is guarded by some sizable groups of [[Shadow Army]].  It is possible to make them and nearby Skeleton Army groups aggro each other to weaken them.  When the groups leading up to the Temple are dead, the gate will open.  Inside are groups of [[Shadow Monk]]s and [[Shadow Mesmer]]s guarding the ramps to the central altar, with groups of [[Abyssal]]s and [[Shadow Beast]]s patroling between them. Pull the first patrol to the door and away from the monks, then work your way around the Temple taking out one group at a time. Atop the central platform are [[Shadow Ranger]]s and more [[Shadow Beast]]s. Clear these out and the Eternal Forgemaster will spawn with your reward.

'''Do not''' take the following quest until your party is ready.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Eternal Weaponsmith
:''"Mortal, aren't you?  You must be some sort of hero to be welcomed into the domain of the God of War.  I can improve any weapons you find, but if you wish to bear armor more fitting to your heroism, you should seek out the '''Forgemaster''' at the heart of the Temple of War."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = Thanks for the advice.
|decline = I am not here for material gain!
| ask = Few are the mortals who have ever worn armor crafted by the Forgemaster himself. While you are here and the favor of Balthazar is upon you, you should find the '''Forgemaster''' and learn whether or not he deems you worthy of wearing his masterful creations.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Eternal Forgemaster
:''"You have helped rid the Temple of War of the vile servants of Menzies. For this do I deem you worthy to receive armor crafted at the forge in the center of the Temple. Bring to me the materials required, and I shall create for you whatever armor you desire."''

==Notes==
*Despite the reward dialogue, you still need to do two more quests to craft Obsidian armor, [[Defend the Temple of War]] and [[Restore the Temple of War]].
*There are spots on the right side of each access ramp of the forge that allows non-tanking players to hide.
**Both the north and south ramps provide such narrow access that they are easily body-blocked should the foes attempt to go round the barriers.
{{bug|Clearing the Eternal Forge area before taking the quest, may sometimes result in [[Eternal Forgemaster|the Forgemaster]] not spawning.}}

==Trivia==
*This quest was added in the [[Game updates/20050511|May 11, 2005]] update.
